sarah: Quick QA — rolling a service port rename in staging and want to confirm secretbinding wiring for NLB TLS passthrough. Changing port name from `http` -> `https` and adding Gateway SecretBinding. Anyone seen gotchas?

ravi: short answer: make sure the Service `port.name` matches the HttpRoute/TCPRoute port name expectation and the gateway's `secretRef`/SecretBinding lives where the gateway expects it. Also externalTrafficPolicy if you care about client IP. :eyes:

sarah: here's the minimal svc + tf diff i'm about to push:```yaml
# k8s service
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: model-inference
  namespace: inference-staging
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
spec:
  type: NodePort
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: model-inference
```
and terraform snippet i plan to add:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "gateway_tls" {
  metadata {
    name      = "gateway-tls"
    namespace = "platform-gateway"
  }
  data = { "tls.crt" = filebase64("cert.crt") }
}

# gateway api SecretBinding placeholder
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "gateway_secretbinding" {
  manifest = <<YAML
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretBinding
metadata:
  name: gateway-tls-binding
  namespace: platform-gateway
secretRef:
  name: gateway-tls
  namespace: platform-gateway
YAML
}
```

tj: Couple quick points —
- If your Service is in `inference-staging` and the Gateway lives in `platform-gateway`, the Secret needs to be in the same namespace as the Gateway or referenced by a SecretBinding that's allowed by our control plane. We added a check in the infra linter last quarter.
- NLB passthrough expects port names to be consistent only when using Gateway API route matching; for straight TCP passthrough the port name doesn't matter but TLS cert lookup does.

maria: Also check the gateway listener config: if it's using `hostname` matching, cert selection may prefer SNI. For test staging run, use curl --resolve and confirm correct cert served.

sarah: thanks — about the linter check, any pointer to what will block CI? I don't want the TF plan to fail in a sneaky way.

ravi: the linter errors are twofold:
- missing SecretBinding in `platform-gateway` namespace referencing your secret => blocks apply
- port name mismatch between service and the route (we enforce `https`/`grpc` naming patterns) => warning but fail on strict mode
Example message: `infra-lint: secretbinding.gateway missing for secret gateway-tls in namespace platform-gateway`

infra-bot: deploy-check: note — existing cluster rolebindings allow gateway to read secrets in `platform-gateway` only. Cross-namespace secret references will be rejected by our policy engine.

sarah: ok i'll create the secret in platform-gateway and use a TF resource to sync it there (copy from inference-staging). i'll open the PR now.

tj: please add a short note in the PR about why externalTrafficPolicy=Local is needed (preserve client IP) and add e2e curl step in the PR description.

maria: also run `kubectl describe gateway <name>` after the apply to confirm `Conditions` show the SecretBinding resolved. If it still shows NotReady, check the gateway controller logs.

sarah: great. PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/412 — tagging @ravi @tj for review. i'll run smoke after merge and post results. :thumbsup:
